title: Project evidence-bound resolutions into top-level Outcome sections
outOfScope: Rewriting any WI-01 through WI-21 archived Contract, Summary, Outcome, or manifest
Changing Outcome locale policy or provider/UI transport behavior
Changing unrelated quality, release, or runtime behavior
Claiming historical Outcomes were retroactively repaired

sources.reason: Archived Outcome demonstrates resolved handoff claims present while top-level Resolutions and Residual Risks render empty, and human confirmations duplicate.
Canonical generator for top-level Outcome sections and human-readable rendering input.
Canonical pre-merge evidence input builder for resolutions and handoff questions.

riskAssessment.reason: If structured resolution evidence reaches only the handoff subsection, the mandatory top-level Outcome sections mislead human reviewers and can omit verified resolution context.

reasons: Initial Work Item skeleton defaults to Standard until scope is classified.

executionDecision.reason: User explicitly requested evidence-bound Outcome self-check correction until all required human-facing fields are populated.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Evidence-bound resolution records supplied to Outcome generation populate top-level Resolutions with problem, action, verification/result, and evidence references.
Remaining risks and evidence-free explanations remain visible in top-level Residual Risks or are explicitly marked inference; no claim is promoted from prose alone.
Human confirmations are order-preserving and de-duplicated without changing their language or evidence status.
Focused generator and ai-finish tests cover resolved, unresolved, malformed, and duplicate decision inputs; historical WI-01 through WI-21 archives remain byte-preserved.
Human-facing documentation records the structured evidence-to-section projection rule.
guidelines: Generate human-facing claims only from structured Summary or verification evidence.
Every non-inference resolution or residual-risk claim must carry evidenceRefs; evidence-free text must be marked inference.
Preserve immutable historical Work Item archives and do not rewrite prior Outcomes.
Keep locale selection bound to the explicit conversation/report language.
Document and test the projection contract, including negative and duplicate-input states.

intent.problem: WI-21 verified that resolution claims can be generated in humanHandoff, but the generic generator still renders top-level Resolutions and Residual Risks as None and duplicates human confirmations.
constraints: Do not rewrite any archived Work Item evidence.
Use structured evidenceRefs for factual claims and mark evidence-free explanations as inference.
Keep the fix bounded to Outcome generation, tests, and authoritative documentation.
intent.rationale: Projecting the same structured evidence into every mandatory human-facing section prevents a reviewer from seeing contradictory or incomplete Outcome surfaces.

declaredIntent.summary: Ensure every mandatory human Outcome section is populated from the same evidence-bound structured resolution and risk records.

rawUserRequest: Continue the evidence-bound self-check loop. Every archived task must clearly explain completed work, problems, stops, resolutions, risks, unknowns, human decisions, verification, and next action; do not rewrite immutable historical archives.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Structured evidence contains a resolved issue with problem, action, verification, and refs.
scenarioCoverage.expectedResult: Top-level Resolutions and humanHandoff resolvedProblems contain the same evidence-bound claim.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused generator and ai-finish integration tests plus Outcome validator.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Unresolved or evidence-free records reach the generator.
scenarioCoverage.expectedResult: Residual Risks remains visible; evidence-free text is explicitly marked inference and never presented as verified resolution.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused negative-path tests and validator checks.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Human decision inputs contain duplicates while historical archives already exist.
scenarioCoverage.expectedResult: Current Outcome deduplicates decisions and WI-01 through WI-21 archives remain byte-preserved.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused duplicate-input test, archive digest comparison, and scope/diff ownership checks.
